params.adminAddress: The address to grant admin role

eip712Domain().details: returns the fields and values that describe the domain separator used by this contract for EIP-712 signature.

getRoleAdmin(bytes32).details: Returns the admin role that controls `role`. See {grantRole} and {revokeRole}. To change a role's admin, use {_setRoleAdmin}.

grantRole(bytes32,address).details: Grants `role` to `account`. If `account` had not been already granted `role`, emits a {RoleGranted} event. Requirements: - the caller must have ``role``'s admin role. May emit a {RoleGranted} event.

returns._0: True if the operator is authorized

params.r: Half of the ECDSA signature pair
params.s: Half of the ECDSA signature pair
params.v: The recovery byte of the signature

renounceRole(bytes32,address).details: Revokes `role` from the calling account. Roles are often managed via {grantRole} and {revokeRole}: this function's purpose is to provide a mechanism for accounts to lose their privileges if they are compromised (such as when a trusted device is misplaced). If the calling account had been revoked `role`, emits a {RoleRevoked} event. Requirements: - the caller must be `callerConfirmation`. May emit a {RoleRevoked} event.

revokeRole(bytes32,address).details: Revokes `role` from `account`. If `account` had been granted `role`, emits a {RoleRevoked} event. Requirements: - the caller must have ``role``'s admin role. May emit a {RoleRevoked} event.

returns.result: True if the interface is supported

DOMAIN_SEPARATOR().notice: Returns the domain separator for EIP712

allowance(address,address,uint256).notice: Mapping of owner to spender to token ID to allowance

approve(address,uint256,uint256).notice: Approves a spender to spend tokens

approveFor(address,address,uint256,uint2.notice: Approves a spender to spend tokens on behalf of owner (only callable by ERC20View)

balanceOf(address,uint256).notice: Mapping of owner to token ID to balance

burn(address,uint256,uint256).notice: Burns tokens from a sender (only callable by OPERATOR_ROLE)

decimals(uint256).notice: Returns the decimals of a token

erc20Views(uint256).notice: Mapping of token ID to ERC20View contract address

isOperator(address,address).notice: Checks if an address is an operator for an account

mint(address,uint256,uint256).notice: Mints tokens to a receiver (only callable by OPERATOR_ROLE)

name(uint256).notice: Returns the name of a token

nonces(address).notice: Mapping of owner to nonce for permit signatures

permit(address,address,uint256,uint256,u.notice: Permits a spender to spend tokens via signature (EIP712)

setContractURI(string).notice: Sets the contract URI (only callable by EDITOR_ROLE)

setOperator(address,bool).notice: Sets an operator for the caller

setOperatorFor(address,address,bool).notice: Sets an operator for an account (only callable by OPERATOR_ROLE)

setTokenMetadata(uint256,(string,string,.notice: Sets token metadata (only callable by EDITOR_ROLE)

supportsInterface(bytes4).notice: Checks if the contract supports an interface

symbol(uint256).notice: Returns the symbol of a token

tokenMetadata(uint256).notice: Mapping of token ID to token metadata

totalSupply(uint256).notice: Mapping of token ID to total supply

transferFrom(address,address,uint256,uin.notice: Transfers tokens from one address to another
